The Migration Amendment (Reinstatement of Temporary Protection Visas) Bill 2013 [No. 2] was introduced to amend the Migration Act 1958 and reinstate temporary protection visas.

The speaker moved to have the Marine Engineers Qualifications Bill 2013 (No. 2) and the Migration Amendment (Reinstatement of Temporary Protection Visas) Bill 2013 [No. 2] considered under a temporary order; the motion was agreed to.
